description: Install node_modules and verify baseline build compiles without errors.
steps: Run `npm install` in /projects/sandbox/odoo-fmcg-accounting/frontend/ to install all dependencies
Run `npm run build` to verify the current code compiles without TypeScript errors
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` completes without errors (exit code 0)
findings: Build initially failed due to useSearchParams() in /admin/accounts page not being wrapped in Suspense boundary (Next.js 16 requirement). Fixed by wrapping the page content in a Suspense component. npm install adds 439 packages. Build compiles successfully with all 18 static pages generated.
